sentences.text: The meeting was a Child in Need review for the Haddon family, held on Tuesday, 24th November.
The family consists of Leanne (mother), Tyler (8 years old, Year Four), and Amelia (7 months old).
Leanne sent apologies; Amelia had a GP appointment that morning and requested that information not be passed to her mother, Sandra.
Tyler's attendance for the current term is 84%, which is below the target of 80%.
Tyler's lateness is mostly Mondays, often rolling in at quarter past or half past nine.
Tyler stated he must prepare Amelia's bottles in the morning before he can go to school.
A lunchtime supervisor reported second-hand that Jordan (Amelia's father/ex-partner) has been dropping Tyler off at the gate on a couple of mornings.
Leanne's mother, Sandra, called the health visitor (Ruth Lindqvist) last Wednesday to tell her that Leanne has stopped taking her sertraline.
Amelia is tracking on the 25th centile for weight and has no faltering growth.
Amelia has had a cough for approximately three weeks and sleeps in the back bedroom which has mould on the wall behind the cot.
Leanne scored fairly high on the PHQ questionnaire and has a low mood.
Leanne stopped taking her sertraline (confirmed by Sandra, but not verified by Leanne or the GP).
Leanne has not been in contact with Jordan since he left in June, and there have been no police call-outs to the address since June.
A neighbour made an anonymous complaint about shouting from the flat late at night a couple of weeks ago.
The family lives in a two-bedroom flat at 22 Ashby Court, second floor.
There is damp coming through the external wall of the back bedroom, not just condensation from washing.
There are no rent arrears; the tenancy is an introductory tenancy reviewed on the 11th of January.
A housing surveyor is booked for Tuesday, 1st December, to inspect the flat.
Leanne is on fortnightly visits with the health visitor; if her weight drops or her chest condition worsens, visits would increase to weekly.
Leanne's mother, Sandra, lives in a one-bedroom flat with her partner.
Leanne has explicitly stated she does not want Sandra involved.
Leanne has been clear she has had no contact with Jordan since he left in June.
Gareth Pryce (Deputy Head/DSL) expressed a concern that the situation regarding Jordan should be referred to a child protection conference.
Hannah Brightwell (Social Worker) stated that the evidence regarding Jordan is second-hand, Leanne denies it, and the police check is clear, so she does not currently see a child保护
Ruth Lindqvist (Health Visitor) agreed with Hannah that there is no child protection threshold from the health perspective.
Gareth Pryce requested that his concern regarding Jordan be noted in the minutes.
Hannah Brightwell indicated she would discuss a Clare's Law disclosure for Leanne with her manager.
Hannah Brightwell planned to speak to her manager by Thursday and email the team by Monday, 30th.
S3 reported that the child is lovely with Amelia and is really attentive.
S2 reported that Tyler adores the child and talks about his mum all the time.
S2 proposed offering Tyler a free breakfast club place every day starting at 8:00.
S3 noted that the breakfast club would help with lates.
S2 stated that Tyler gets fed at the breakfast club.
S1 reported that she mentioned the breakfast club to Leanne on Thursday and that Leanne is keen.
S2 proposed that Tyler start the breakfast club on Monday the thirtieth.
S2 suggested that the mum would benefit from a parenting course run by the Family Hub on Wednesdays.
S1 reported that Leanne said no to the parenting course, feeling it would imply she is a bad mum.
S1 reported that Leanne expressed a wish to attend the stay and play at the Family Hub for Amelia to meet other mums.
S3 offered to make the perinatal referral for Amelia via an online form.
Ruth Lindqvist agreed to arrange a perinatal mental health referral for Leanne.
The perinatal mental health referral is scheduled for Friday, 27th.
S1 proposed that S3 refers Leanne and Amelia to the stay and play.
S3 confirmed the perinatal referral deadline as Friday.
S3 confirmed the stay and play referral deadline as Friday the fourth.
S1 proposed that S3 makes the perinatal referral by Friday.
S1 proposed that S4 (Darren) acts as the surveyor on Tuesday the first and sends the report.
S4 agreed to aim for the survey report within a week of the visit.
S1 proposed that S2 (Gareth) sends an attendance breakdown with lates broken down by day.
S2 confirmed the attendance breakdown deadline as Friday.
S1 proposed that S1 will speak to her manager about Jordan information and the Clare's Law question, and email everyone by Monday the thirtieth.
S1 stated that the CAMHS referral was not agreed upon during this meeting.
S1 stated that the move to Sandra's is not happening and is not a decision.
S1 stated that the management move is conditional on the survey results and nothing was agreed on that.
S4 confirmed that the management move is Darren's decision, depending on the survey.
S1 proposed the next review be held on Tuesday the fifteenth of December at 10:00 at the school.
S2 confirmed that the fifteenth is fine and offered to book the room.
S4 confirmed they can attend the fifteenth and offered to dial in again.
S3 confirmed attendance for the fifteenth.
S1 stated that S1 will share the meeting notes with Leanne.
S3 stated she would send photos to S1 and S4 today.
